title: Fort Lennox
scope: Standing Fort Lennox National Historic Site, including the bastioned enclosure, open central parade, six heritage buildings, casemate fronts, gate and two principal approach bridges.
limitations: The model represents the standing historic park with the four earthen bastions and open parade, original exterior buildings, ravelin and bridges. Earlier fortifications, movable objects and private interiors are outside the scope.

The raw terrain is preserved. The berm cross sections and stone gate lintels, bridge deck heights, casemate openings and building heights are modest estimates constrained by the native feature geometry and federal heritage records.
The 1923 photo describes the surviving palette only in grayscale. Roof and stone colors are estimates. Modern visitor infrastructure and historic activities are outside the scope.
